packageRules.description: Fix subchart archives for helm chart

patch updates: automerges. Digests, pins, rollbacks, replacements and pinDigest updates are deliberately ignored since in our use case, these need a manual decision about the version bump for the chart. This can be removed when https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/issues/8231 is implemented and enabled.
